title: Twin Shadow
next_chapter_hook: Outside the Tianji Record space, Su Qingyao, Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect, suddenly sensed the chaotic spiritual energy fluctuations within Chen Ji's body and rushed over immediately—and in the distant Demonic Path, Ye Qing simultaneously raised his head, gazing toward the east.

text.content:
Like the receding tide, the lingering resentment faded away. Chen Ji thought everything had returned to peace. However, just as he tried to reconcentrate his consciousness, an unprecedented pulling force erupted from the depths of the Tianji Record. As if an invisible hand had seized his soul and violently dragged him into the endless abyss.

"——!"

Chen Ji wanted to scream for help, only to find himself unable to utter any sound. The surrounding scenery crumbled and reorganized like shattered glass, golden light intertwining with pitch-black void, eventually transforming into a vast, boundless sea of stars. He floated within this star sea, beneath his feet an endless flow of fate threads, densely woven, connecting all things and beings.

This was the internal space of the Tianji Record—the forbidden place that had never opened to anyone. Chen Ji had glimpsed fragments within the残页, but had never truly entered. He could sense that every strand of fate connected to some being's life trajectory, bright or dim, strong or weak.

And now, those threads were trembling at an almost fanatical frequency, as if welcoming some important existence.

"You've finally arrived."

The cold voice rang out from all directions simultaneously, carrying the居高临下的scrutinizing与detached。Chen Ji spun around sharply, his pupils contracting to the extreme—

dialogue.content: "I have waited for this moment... for a very long time."

text.content:
Chen Ling.

That was another "Chen Ji."

The same brows and eyes, the same features, even the same gray robe worn by a Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple. Yet when Chen Ji gazed upon that face identical to his own, he felt a bone-penetrating chill—those eyes held no emotional fluctuation whatsoever, only the cold, detached "observation" of everything.

As if all phenomena in the world were merely a chess game in his eyes, and all living beings were pieces that could be discarded at any moment.

"Who are you?" Chen Ji's voice sank, his hand unconsciously tightening, though he knew he was currently within an意识 space with no physical body for combat.

dialogue.content:
"Who am I?" Chen Ling's lips curved slightly upward, that smile cold as the nine yin cold ice, "I am Chen Ji—or rather, I am the true Chen Ji. And you... are merely the 'good intention' I voluntarily split off eight hundred years ago."

His voice was terrifyingly calm, each word like a nail driving into Chen Ji's heart.

"The position of Observer should belong to me. You are merely the burden I carved away to escape this endless cycle. Now... it is time to return to your proper place."

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, yet showed no panic on his face. He slowly surveyed his surroundings, gazing at those ever-flowing fate threads, then suddenly laughed softly.

"The 'good intention' that was split off?" He met Chen Ling's gaze directly, his eyes carrying a searching quality, "If I were truly your good intention, then what would you call this current desire to devour me? Evil intention? Or... is that simply what you are—an existence so unworthy?"

Chen Ling's eyes narrowed slightly—it was the first time he showed emotional fluctuation.

"You have a sharp tongue indeed." Chen Ling stepped forward, the surrounding star sea trembling with his movement, "But you will soon understand—the position of Observer cannot be taken through mere words."

dialogue.content:
"Do you think that over these eight hundred years, youradvance step by step in the Tianqing Sect and secret scheming for the world were achieved through your own abilities?" Chen Ling's voice carried mockery, "Wrong. Those so-called schemes, that wisdom you believed belonged to yourself... were nothing more than the instinctive driving force remaining in the split fragments."

He extended his hand, pointing at Chen Ji's heart.

"Why do you consume so much Heavenly Fate Value every time you use the Tianji Record's foresight? Because that power was originally lent to you by me. And now..." His voice dropped, carrying undeniable certainty, "It is time to take it back."

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his chest, and indeed saw a faintly visible golden thread there, connecting directly to Chen Ling. At the other end of the thread, it seemed endless energy was continuously flowing into Chen Ling's body.

Was this the true reason his Heavenly Fate Value consumption far exceeded that of others?

Yet Chen Ji soon raised his head, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his mouth.

"If what you say is true..." His voice was terrifyingly calm, "Then why don't you simply take action? Why bother talking nonsense with me?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji stared directly into Chen Ling's cold eyes and slowly spoke: "Since you wish to prove you are the true Observer, then give me a reason—one worthy of making me abandon eight hundred years of memories and bonds."

choices.description: Pierce through the flaws in Chen Ling's words, attack instead of defend, probe his bottom line.
choices.risk_hint: May trigger stronger suppression from Chen Ling

text.content:
Chen Ling's smile froze for an instant. He seemed unprepared for this "split-off good intention" to actually dare question him.

"...Interesting." Chen Ling slowly retracted the hand pointing at Chen Ji, "You want to know the reason? Fine, I shall tell you."

His voice suddenly dropped low: "Because you have already seen your own death. The prophecy in Chapter 700—the destined ending—has only 27 days remaining. And I... can rewrite it."

choices.description: Pretend to waver, lower Chen Ling's guard, extract more truth about the Observer and the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling may see through the disguise

text.content:
Chen Ji deliberately drooped his eyes, his voice carrying a tremor: "You're right... all these years I did feel the Tianji Record's power gradually draining away. Perhaps... perhaps I truly am just your burden."

A flash of triumph appeared in Chen Ling's eyes. He stepped closer, about to speak, when Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, his gaze like a blade: "But you overlooked one thing—if I were truly just a burden, why would you need my 'consent' to merge?"

The air suddenly froze.

A true crack finally appeared in Chen Ling's expression.

choices.description: Speak without arrogance or subservience, indicate willingness to negotiate, explore a third path—possibilities beyond mere fusion.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling may refuse to compromise

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly spoke: "Fine, I acknowledge your existence. But if you want to devour me, prepare for mutual destruction. If you want fusion, give me time to handle unfinished matters."

Chen Ling fell silent for a moment, then suddenly smiled—this time, there was a hint of playfulness in that smile.

"Interesting. You're much calmer than I anticipated." He stood with hands behind his back. "Since that's the case, I'll give you 27 days. Finish dealing with your so-called bonds, then... we can talk again."

In the starry sea, two figures stood facing each other. The threads of destiny whirled madly around them, as if trembling for this confrontation that concerned the pattern of heaven and earth.

Chen Ji stared directly into Chen Ling's endless eyes, and suddenly remembered something. His sister Chen Nian—the one taken by the Holy Sect, the existence known as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key."

Why had Chen Ling never mentioned Chen Nian?

"You mentioned that I was a scattered fragment," Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned sharp. "Then I ask you—what about Chen Nian? Is she your fragment, or... an existence like me?"

dialogue.content:
A genuine fluctuation finally appeared in Chen Ling's expression.

"...You shouldn't know of her existence."

This single sentence made everything clear in Chen Ji's heart. Chen Nian was definitely not Chen Ling's fragment—she was some kind of variable that even Chen Ling couldn't control. This might be the key that allowed him to maintain leverage in this confrontation.

"It seems I guessed correctly." Chen Ji's lips curved upward. "Chen Nian is a flaw in your plan, isn't she? You need me, yet cannot forcibly devour me... because you're afraid of her."

text.content:
Chen Ling remained silent for a long time.

When he spoke again, the arrogance in his voice had diminished somewhat, replaced by a deeper, more dangerous scrutiny.

"You are indeed more valuable than I anticipated." He slowly nodded. "It seems that in these eight hundred years of separation, you've grown far more complete than I expected."

The starry sea began to tremble, and Chen Ling's figure gradually became blurred.

"Since that's the case, I've changed my mind." His voice came from all directions. "I will not devour you—I want to fuse with you. Then, you and I will become the true 'Observers,' jointly commanding the complete power of the Tianji Record."

choice.prompt: Chen Ling gave his final proposal: fusion, not devouring. The two would become complete Observers, sharing the Tianji Record's power. Is this a trap, or a genuine path forward?

choices.description: Merge with Chen Ling into one, gaining the complete power of the Tianji Record, but at the cost of losing independent personality.
choices.visible_reward: Complete power of the Tianji Record

text.content:
"Fusion?" Chen Ji chewed on this word, then suddenly laughed. "What bold words. You keep calling me a burden, a fragment, yet now you need my cooperation to complete your plan... Chen Ling, who is really depending on whom?"

Chen Ling's eyes slightly narrowed.

"What are you trying to say?"

"What I mean is—" Chen Ji stepped forward. "I can consider fusion, but I have conditions."

choices.description: No matter what Chen Ling says, never fuse with him. Preserve independent personality and seek other ways to break the deadlock.
choices.visible_cost: Resist the temptation of immense power

text.content:
"No."

Chen Ji's answer was straightforward, without the slightest hesitation.

"I don't care what Observer's本体 you claim to be, nor how alluring the future you're描绘ing is." His voice was steady as a mountain. "I am Chen Ji. I have my own memories, my own bonds, my own people I want to protect. These are not things you can erase with a few words of truth."

Chen Ling's expression completely chilled.

"...You will regret this."

choices.description: Neither directly accept nor refuse, but propose your own conditions: preserve Chen Nian, preserve self-awareness, preserve bonds with Su Qingyao and others.
choices.visible_reward: Maximize preservation of one's own interests

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer immediately. Instead, he paced slowly through the Star Sea, as if genuinely contemplating the proposal.

"Fusion... is acceptable." He finally spoke. "But I have three conditions. First, Chen Nian must be retrieved by my own hands—her fate is not for you to control. Second, Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and others must be preserved. They are my allies, not your chess pieces."

He turned to face Chen Ling directly: "Third—after fusion, who will dominate this body?"

The atmosphere in the Star Sea froze to an icy point.

Chen Ling looked at this "fragment split off from himself," and the scrutiny in his eyes was finally completely replaced by something complex. He remained silent for a long time—so long that Chen Ji almost thought he would never speak again.

"You truly are not me." Chen Ling finally said, his voice carrying a hint of sighing. "If it were me from eight hundred years ago, I would never have asked such a question."

He turned away, his back to Chen Ji, gazing at the endless threads of fate.

"Forget it. I can accept two of your three conditions—the ownership of Chen Nian, and the preservation of those mortals." His voice paused. "As for the third... after fusion, who dominates this body will be decided by our own abilities."

dialogue.content:
"This is not an equal partnership." Chen Ji spoke bluntly.

"This is already the greatest concession." Chen Ling turned around, his gaze like an abyss. "I am different from you. I am the Observer, the本体 of the Tianji Record. You are merely a fragment—no matter how perfectly you behave like a complete person, this fact cannot be changed."

He raised his hand, pointing at Chen Ji's heart.

"How much Heavenly Fate do you have left? Two hundred? Three hundred? But what the Prophecy of Chapter 700 requires to consume... is one thousand." His voice was cold and certain. "You have no capital to refuse."

choice.prompt: Chen Ling gave the final answer: fusion was the only way out, and the gap in Heavenly Fate was an insurmountable chasm. The deadly prophecy in 27 days seemed already unavoidable...

choices.description: Agree to make a choice within 27 days, using this time to lay out schemes, ensuring that even if fusion occurs, the losses can be minimized.
choices.visible_cost: Must face the choice in 27 days
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling may be laying schemes during this period

text.content:
"Very well." Chen Ji took a deep breath. "27 days. But I have one additional condition—during these 27 days, you must not interfere with any of my actions, nor窥探 my thoughts through the Tianji Record."

Chen Ling's eyes narrowed slightly, as if evaluating the feasibility of this condition.

"...Acceptable." He finally nodded. "But if you attempt to escape this space or damage the foundations of the Tianji Record, the agreement becomes void."

The two reached a delicate balance within the Star Sea.

choices.description: Do not accept Chen Ling's premise—the Prophecy of Chapter 700 may be rewritable, and fusion is not the only solution.
choices.visible_reward: May discover flaws in the prophecy
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling may completely turn hostile

text.content:
"You said the Prophecy of Chapter 700 requires consuming one thousand Heavenly Fate." Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice carrying a dangerous sharpness. "But have you ever wondered—why Chapter 700? Why that particular number?"

Chen Ling's expression changed slightly.

"You mean..."

"What I mean is," Chen Ji stepped forward, "perhaps you have been designed from the very beginning. The Prophecy of Chapter 700, the consumption of Heavenly Fate, the so-called inescapable doom—are these truly your own will, or the chess game of a higher existence?"

The Star Sea trembled violently at this moment.

In Chen Ling's eyes, true fluctuation finally appeared for the first time.

Deep within the Star Sea, a faint purple-golden light suddenly flickered.

That was... the Will Projection of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

Chen Ling had clearly sensed something as well. His expression became extremely complex in an instant—wariness, anger, and something deeply buried: fear.

"You sensed it?" Chen Ling's voice was low. "That thing has been watching us. From the moment I split apart eight hundred years ago... it has been watching."

Chen Ji gazed at that purple-golden light and suddenly understood something.

Chen Ling wanted him to fuse, perhaps not just for "completeness"—but to oppose the chess game of that higher existence. He was a chess piece, and so was Chen Ling. And the two of them combined might just have the qualification to overturn the entire board.

"I understand." Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice carrying a certain resolve. "You don't want to devour me, nor do you want to fuse with me—you need me, need a partner capable of 'independent thinking.' Because you yourself... have already been lost in those eight hundred years of reincarnation."

Chen Ling said nothing, but his silence was the best answer.

"Very well." Chen Ji took a deep breath. "27 days. Before the Prophecy of Chapter 700 arrives, I will find a third path—one that is neither fusion nor fighting separately."

He turned around, gazing at that vast Star Sea: "I will prove to you that even a fragment can overturn an entire chess game."

The Star Sea began to collapse, and the internal space of the Tianji Record was expelling Chen Ji. Before his consciousness completely returned to his body, he heard Chen Ling's final words—

"The Prophecy of Chapter 700 has already begun its countdown. In 27 days... I await your answer."
